comment: Default-FAIL verification contract for the T-004 quality gate. Every check started at passes=false and was flipped only after the gate host RAN its command at the current HEAD and inspected the saved output; the implementation report was treated as a claim throughout. Every passing check points at output produced by specs/epic-195-a7-compatibility/verification/qg-cycle2/T-004/run-checks.sh, which is re-runnable and echoes each command into the log it produces -- never at an implementer-authored log. The tdd red/green pairs are the exception and are deliberately implementer-authored: a RED can only be captured before the fix exists, so it cannot be honestly re-created afterwards. The recorded red_evidence is malformed-corpus-red.log, the pre-fix capture of the coherent malformed-corpus case tasks.md#T-004 Done When requires -- NOT the earlier red-sh.log/red-ps1.log preflight bail-out, which quality-gate cycle 1 (ledger seq0674) rejected as the wrong RED. Its authenticity was audited rather than assumed; see qg-cycle2/T-004/malformed-red-audit.log. Risk high and Required Workflow tdd are transcribed from tasks.md#T-004 and independently re-checked by qg-cycle2/T-004/risk.log. RECAPTURE (2026-08-25, cross-model panel remediation): unit-tests/acceptance-tests are repointed from qg-cycle2/T-004/acceptance.log to acceptance-rerun-20260825.log, because tests/structural-compatibility.tests.{sh,ps1} changed this session. Three sh/ps1 twin divergences the anthropic slot recorded as Minor were closed: the Bash named-SKIP renderer emitted a trailing space inside the dependency parentheses where PowerShell did not (a 'sed s/+$/ /' typo, now asserted in both twins so it cannot silently return); the Bash anchor-fingerprint extractor was greedy and took the LAST sha256 in the span where the PowerShell twin's lazy match took the FIRST; and 'sed | head -1' under pipefail coupled a variable assignment to SIGPIPE. On that last one the finding is directionally right but overstated -- measured, SIGPIPE needs sed's output to exceed the pipe buffer, so the second schema match the finding names would not in fact have tripped it. Removed regardless. Both twins report 44/0 and now emit byte-identical SKIP lines (cmp-verified); the suite's own 116-case mutation proof re-runs 116 killed / 0 survived against the modified suite. NOT CLOSED, reported for human decision: T-004 authored specs/epic-195-a7-compatibility/human-copy/.github/workflows/test.yml and its MANIFEST.sha256 entry and declares both in its Outputs, while tasks.md Global Constraints and T-011's own Planned Files make T-011 the sole task that edits that file and owns that staging route, and traceability.md lists both paths under T-011. Today's T-011/T-013 split did not move that ownership. Unwinding it would leave the suite unregistered in CI until T-011 runs and risks a collision when it does; reassigning it means editing frozen, hash-bound documents. Neither is a coder-session decision.

checks.waiver_reason: stack: shell -- T-004's deliverables are the POSIX-shell/PowerShell twins tests/structural-compatibility.tests.{sh,ps1} and tests/lib/markdown-ast-canonicalizer.{sh,ps1}, plus a JSON fixture corpus. This repository configures no shell linter (no shellcheck and no PSScriptAnalyzer invocation in tests/run-all.{sh,ps1} or .github/workflows/test.yml), so there is no lint command whose output could be recorded. risk-gate-matrix.md Stack descriptor.

stack: shell -- shell and PowerShell are untyped and this repository configures no static type-check command for either runtime. The structured artifacts, the four structural-fixture-corpus/v1 JSON files, have their envelope shape enforced by the delivered suite's own Valid-Envelope assertions rather than by a type checker. risk-gate-matrix.md Stack descriptor.

No service or network integration is in T-004's scope. AC-030 requires the opposite property -- the gating suite must run fully offline against the recorded corpus and never make a live model call -- so there is no integration layer to exercise. The one cross-process interaction, the suite invoking the canonicalizer twins, is exercised end to end by the acceptance run.

stack: shell -- no compile or bundle step exists for shell/PowerShell scripts and JSON fixtures; there is no dist/ artifact and design.md's Deployment / CI Plan records no build obligation for this task. risk-gate-matrix.md Stack descriptor.

No independently startable application, service, or UI. T-004's deliverable is a batch test suite plus a library the suite calls; the acceptance run invokes both entry points for real in both runtimes, so a separate smoke run would duplicate the acceptance evidence rather than add to it.

No baseline-behavior.md exists for this feature and T-004 is new additive tooling rather than a change to existing behavior, so no differential obligation attaches (references/differential-test-policy.md). The recorded structural-fixture-corpus/v1 this task creates is a comparison oracle, not a differential baseline for T-004's own change.
No user-facing UI surface. traceability.md's Layer Coverage records UX and Frontend as reasoned N/A for the whole feature: 'no GUI, view, dialog, menu item, or human interactive shell surface'.

ds_profile: none -- this repository carries no design-system/ directory and T-004 touches no UI-layer file, so check-design-system's warn-phase conditional control does not activate (risk-gate-matrix.md footnote 4).
